title: MCP link_student Response
description: Serving-integrity contract U11/R15: `tools/mcp_server.py`'s `link_student` tool response, built by `_serialize_link`. U4/R17: confirms the link this server's own consumer_id (never a caller-supplied value) now has to student_id, echoing back only opaque ids and the caller's own link_basis provenance string — never the attributes that proved the match.

linked.description: Always true on a successful response — a failed link (unregistered student_id, mismatched attributes) raises a tool error instead of returning linked=false.

student_id.description: The student_id the link was made to.

consumer_id.description: This server's own startup-configured consumer_id (KTD2) — never a tool parameter, so this always echoes server configuration.

link_basis.description: orchestrator/identity.py's IdentityRegistry.link_student: an optional, unverified consent-provenance string recorded verbatim (e.g. "guardian_authorized"), or null when none was given.
